title: Updating the input-length register
statement: For a register state $\sigma$ and a natural number $y$, updating entry $0$ of its register vector to $y$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing the input-length component of $\sigma$ by $y$.
replaced:
For a register record and a natural number $y$, updating the entry at index $0$ of its
length-fifteen value vector to $y$ gives the value vector of the record obtained by
replacing its input-length component with $y$.
